name.ja: SD ガンダム 三国伝 006 真 孫権ガンダム
name.en: SD Gundam Sangokuden 006 Shin Sunken Gundam

ja: • 孫一族に伝わる伝説の剣。伝説の三侯のうち白虎の魂が宿る剣とも云われる「虎錠刀」（こていとう）が付属！ • 目のシールは「通常時」と「戦闘時」の２つ入っているので好きな方をえらんで、貼ろう！ 成形品×5、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書
en: • A legendary sword handed down to the Sun family. Includes the "Tiger Sword ", which is said to be the sword that contains the soul of the white tiger, one of the three legendary lords! • There are two eye seals, one for " normal " and one for " combat", so choose the one you like and stick it on! Molded product x 5, foil seal x 1, assembly manual
